newsitem.title: ITALY: Italy's Prodi to meet coalition leaders, Dini Tues.
newsitem.headline: Italy's Prodi to meet coalition leaders, Dini Tues.

text.p: Italian Prime Minister Romano Prodi will lunch on Tuesday with the leaders of parties in his centre-left Olive Tree coalition, plus Foreign Minister Lamberto Dini who heads the Italian Renewal party, his office said.

The meeting, at 1200 GMT, comes before a scheduled meeting with parliamentary party leaders of the ruling majority at 1400 GMT at which the hard-left Communist Refoundation will be present. The meeting is to discuss the forthcoming mini-budget.
Dini's group is a key ally but not part of the Olive Tree.

Prodi needs Communist Refoundation support for a majority in parliament but the party is opposed to the mini-budget and one of its leaders was quoted on Monday as saying that it might have to make "difficult decisions" over its support for Prodi.
